metadata.question: Was there more smoke on January 1, 2020 in the coastal regions of Victoria and New South Wales, Australia compared to July 24, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI CO (carbon monoxide) or aerosol index as a proxy for smoke - Alternative: MODIS fire/thermal anomalies or aerosol optical depth - Dates: January 1, 2020 vs July 24, 2019 - Location: Coastal regions of Victoria and New South Wales, Australia 2. Masking strategy: - For smoke/aerosol products, we generally don't mask clouds as smoke is in the atmosphere - Use quality flags if available - The question is about smoke presence, not clouds 3. Logic: - Compare mean aerosol/CO values between the two dates - Valid zero means no smoke (answer could be B if Jan 2020 < July 2019) - If either date has no data after quality filtering → C1 or C2 - If calculation returns None/NaN → C3 - January 2020 was during major Australian bushfires, so likely higher smoke 4. Implementation: - Use Sentinel-5P CO or aerosol index - Define coastal regions geometry for Victoria and NSW - Compare mean values between dates ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define coastal regions of Victoria and New South Wales const victoria = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[140.96, -39.16], [149.98, -39.16], [149.98, -37.50], [140.96, -37.50], [140.96, -39.16]] ]); const nsw = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[149.98, -37.50], [153.64, -37.50], [153.64, -28.16], [149.98, -28.16], [149.98, -37.50]] ]); const region = victoria.union(nsw); // Date ranges const date1 = '2019-07-24'; const date2 = '2020-01-01'; // Use Sentinel-5P CO (carbon monoxide) as smoke proxy const col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_CO') .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(region) .select('CO_column_number_density'); const col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_CO') .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(region) .select('CO_column_number_density'); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`July 24, 2019 images: ${size1}`); console.log(`January 1, 2020 images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('Missing data for one or both dates'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get mean images const img1 = col1.mean(); const img2 = col2.mean(); // Calculate statistics const stats1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean1 = stats1.CO_column_number_density_mean; const count1 = stats1.CO_column_number_density_count; const mean2 = stats2.CO_column_number_density_mean; const count2 = stats2.CO_column_number_density_count; console.log(`July 24, 2019 - Mean CO: ${mean1}, Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`Jan 1, 2020 - Mean CO: ${mean2}, Pixels: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (mean1 === null || mean1 === undefined || mean2 === null || mean2 === undefined) { console.log('Calculation returned invalid values'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare: was there MORE smoke on Jan 1, 2020? if (mean2 > mean1) { console.log(`More smoke on Jan 1, 2020 (${(mean2/mean1).toFixed(2)}x higher CO)`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Less or equal smoke on Jan 1, 2020'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
